candidats.titre: File:Bike and cladding Træ Sydhavnen Træ office block Southern Harbour Aarhus Denmark.jpg
candidats.description: Focus on a bike parked, free-standing, on path in front of a section of facade. The facade is wooden casing and picturesquely worn metal cladding. Low greenery in a flower bed borders where the foundation meets the path. This is Træ building at Jægergårdsgade and Kalkværksvej at Sydhavnen - the Southern Harbour quarter, Aarhus, Denmark. It is 20 storeys and 78 metres high. At the time of construction: Denmark's tallest wooden building. Concrete and glass are also used and lots of the material is reused or recycled. candidats.description: Like a tribute to Gaudí, the Casa Comalat contains many elements of Gaudí's architecture, and is one of the most original examples of home-grown art nouveau in Barcelona: modernisme. Two distinct façades, both of them showing the influence of the curve redolent of the work of the Reus-born maestro, arouse our curiosity to go and take a closer look at this beautiful and unique building. The architect Salvador Valeri i Pupurull worked on the Casa Comalat from 1906 to 1911, and was clearly influenced by Gaudi's organic forms.
